2.name: Felix and Sable cross market
2.description: Felix and Sable move together through the crowded market square.
evidence: A busy morning market. Merchants and buyers weave between stalls. Felix and Sable move through the crowd.

2.name: Sable's satchel clasp breaks
2.description: As Sable tries to open her worn leather satchel, its clasp snaps and she has to hold it shut by hand.
evidence: Sable carries a worn LEATHER SATCHEL over one shoulder. She reaches to open it and the CLASP BREAKS -- the leather tab snapping clean. She grips it shut with her hand.

2.name: Felix suggests cobbler repair
2.description: Felix responds to Sable's broken satchel by telling her to take it to the cobbler.
evidence:
FELIX
Take it to the cobbler.

2.name: Wren intercepts Felix and Sable
2.description: Wren Aldous steps into Felix and Sable's path and addresses Felix directly.
evidence: WREN ALDOUS (50s, broad-shouldered, prosperously dressed) steps from between two stalls directly into their path. A MERCHANT'S BADGE is pinned visibly to his coat.

WREN
Master Adler. I have been hoping to find you.

2.name: Wren offers to buy map
2.description: Wren bluntly offers Felix two hundred gold coins for the Northern Reaches map, either immediately or upon completion.
evidence:
WREN
I will be direct. I want to purchase the Northern Reaches map. Two hundred gold coins. Today, or when it is complete.

2.name: Felix refuses to sell map
2.description: Felix stops and firmly states that the map is not for sale.
evidence:
FELIX
It is not for sale.

2.name: Felix asserts ownership of map
2.description: Felix emphasizes the personal labor invested in the map and insists that he alone will decide its fate.
evidence:
FELIX
(quietly)
Six months of my life are in that map. My surveys, my corrections, my ink. I will decide what happens to it.

2.name: Felix ends encounter and leaves
2.description: After rejecting Wren's offer, Felix dismisses him and walks away, with Sable following.
evidence:
WREN
Two hundred gold is a fair price.
He walks past. Sable follows, holding her broken satchel shut

2.name: Wren watches them calculatingly
2.description: As Felix and Sable depart, Wren remains behind and watches them with calculating intent.
evidence: glancing back at Wren, who watches them with calculating eyes.
